data.how_to_apply: The page states that everyone is welcome to apply, with priority given to junior members of the community (full- or part-time students of computer science and related fields). Volunteers receive a complimentary conference registration covering all open sessions and proceedings, free lunches/refreshments during breaks, a volunteer shirt, and free admission to social events. They are responsible for their own travel and accommodation. To apply, one must send an email to thalakottur.m@northeastern.edu, robert.zhang@utexas.edu, or hnzhu@ucdavis.edu if they have questions, though the page also provides a direct link to apply.
